title: After the Takarazuka Kinen: Watch Out World!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The reporter with the round glasses, who was watching quietly, draws courage from the scene and vows to work harder.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, thrilled with her win and ready to take on some more powerhouses, Matikanetannhauser immediately suggests making the Japan Cup her next goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She may not be confident in her ability to win, but she wants to give it a try… And so our days preparing for the Japan Cup begin!
